u0: Idle/ready state, and the reward machine's final success state for a completed client cycle: no active client order remains (the previous client, if any, has been served). Wait for the next client_arrived; when a client appears, switch to u1 and begin taking that client's order. At reset and after a serve the hands are normally empty; food fetched early before a client arrives is not tracked in this state.
u1: A client is waiting and its order has not yet been taken. Next objective: face the client and toggle to take the order. If already carrying food, taking the order moves to u3 with food in hand; if empty-handed without a just-occurred slip, it moves to u2 and a pantry fetch is needed. If food slips before the order, move to u3: recover the fallen portion on the very next move and still take the order before preparing.
u2: The client's order has been taken, but the agent has no food in hand and no food has just slipped. Next objective: go to the pantry, face it, and pick up raw food. A successful pickup (holding_food) or a slip on that pickup (food_fell) moves to u3; if the food slips, recover it on the very next move. Do not go to the stove or client empty-handed.
u3: Food-handling stage for the waiting client: either raw food is in hand (the order may still need taking if the food was fetched early) or the food has slipped/dropped and is on the floor awaiting recovery. Next objective: recover lost food on the very next move if it fell; take the order if it is not yet taken; then, with raw food and the order taken, go to the stove and toggle to prepare. food_prepared advances to u4. Do not idle empty-handed when there is no fresh slip event.
u4: Prepared-food delivery stage: the food has been prepared (green), the client's order is taken, and the order has not yet been served. If the prepared food is in hand, go to the waiting client and toggle to serve; if it slipped at or after preparation, recover it from the floor on the very next move, then serve. order_served returns to u0 and completes this client cycle; empty-handed waiting without a fresh slip is an undesirable stall.
